verdict.rationale: LightSprint documents creating tasks directly from Slack, with updates syncing both ways, and says background cloud agents can work through bug backlogs. That covers delegating work from a chat tool, but nothing shows @-tagging an agent inside a thread or holding a back-and-forth discussion with it there. Missing for 10: explicit agent mention/tagging in chat threads, conversational discussion with the agent in-thread, documentation of the Slack flow, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a developer, I can tag an agent in a chat thread to discuss and delegate a bug or task

citations.quote: Create LightSprint tasks directly from Slack, Linear, or Jira. Updates sync both ways
